from solution import moddiv_list


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Checks example moddiv_list([4,5,6],[1,2,3])==[0,1,0]."""
    assert moddiv_list([4, 5, 6], [1, 2, 3]) == [0, 1, 0]  # 4%1=0, 5%2=1, 6%3=0


def test_issue_single_pair():
    """Checks modulo division of two single-element lists."""
    assert moddiv_list([7], [3]) == [1]  # 7%3=1 (7=2*3+1)


def test_issue_empty_lists():
    """Checks modulo division of two empty lists is empty."""
    assert moddiv_list([], []) == []  # no pairs so no remainders


def test_issue_zero_numerators():
    """Checks zero modulo any divisor is zero."""
    assert moddiv_list([0, 0], [5, 7]) == [0, 0]  # 0%5=0, 0%7=0


def test_issue_divisor_one_gives_zero():
    """Checks any number modulo one is zero."""
    assert moddiv_list([9, 10, 11], [1, 1, 1]) == [0, 0, 0]  # 9%1=0, 10%1=0, 11%1=0


def test_issue_dividend_smaller_than_divisor():
    """Checks dividend smaller than divisor returns dividend."""
    assert moddiv_list([1, 2], [5, 7]) == [1, 2]  # 1%5=1, 2%7=2


def test_issue_equal_values_give_zero():
    """Checks equal dividend and divisor gives zero."""
    assert moddiv_list([5, 8], [5, 8]) == [0, 0]  # 5%5=0, 8%8=0


def test_issue_larger_remainders():
    """Checks modulo division with larger mixed remainders."""
    assert moddiv_list([10, 17, 20], [3, 5, 7]) == [1, 2, 6]  # 10%3=1, 17%5=2, 20%7=6


def test_contract_returns_list_type():
    """Checks moddiv_list returns a list."""
    result = moddiv_list([4, 5], [2, 3])
    assert result == [0, 2]  # 4%2=0, 5%3=2
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_contract_does_not_mutate_inputs():
    """Checks moddiv_list does not mutate its input lists."""
    a = [4, 5, 6]
    b = [1, 2, 3]
    result = moddiv_list(a, b)
    assert result == [0, 1, 0]  # 4%1=0, 5%2=1, 6%3=0
    assert a == [4, 5, 6] and b == [1, 2, 3]


def test_contract_preserves_length_and_order():
    """Checks result length and order match positional pairing."""
    assert moddiv_list([8, 9, 10], [3, 4, 5]) == [2, 1, 0]  # 8%3=2, 9%4=1, 10%5=0
